resources.string: Stop AI execution and keep it inhibited across restart? In-flight work may already have taken effect. This screen will not resend the stop or resume tasks automatically.
Request another mechanical stop with a new operation ID? This repeats cancellation only. It will not resend a turn, repeat effects, clear the inhibit or prove rollback.
Local control state is unavailable. Check that the device has no inhibit, then durably allow new turns? Previous outcomes stay unknown and previous turns will not be repeated.
